entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your order number, please?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
I just don't like it. The whole thing is hard to use.
I'm sorry to hear it's not meeting your expectations. Could you tell me a bit more about what you're finding difficult? Sometimes there's a setting we can adjust.
The interface is just... confusing. I've read the user manual twice. I just expected more from it. I want my money back.
I understand your frustration. Let me just check the return eligibility on your order. Please hold for one moment.
Okay, thank you for waiting. I've checked the policy, and since you received the item 42 days ago, you're still well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that for you.
Fine. So you're actually going to do it?

Yes, absolutely. I've initiated the return for you. You should receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and return instructions within the next 15 minutes. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
My apologies for any inconvenience. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
